name: bang-film
description: Bang Film — an agent skill that designs AI live-action video and writes the prompts, without generating anything itself.

plugins.name: bang-film
plugins.description: Microdrama series, short films and single scenes, planned through seven gates with three approvals: concept, cast and set bible, shot list, asset prompts and eleven-block video prompts ready to paste into any AI image and video model. A checker verifies locked blocks, timecodes, 4–30 second generations and banned words before handover.
